headline: Reliance Jio Introduces Three-Year Unlimited Subscription Plan
summary: Reliance Jio has launched a long-term 3-year unlimited telecom and digital bundle plan priced at 10,000 rupees.
why: Long-term subscription plans are used by telecom operators to lock in customers, reduce churn, and secure upfront cash flow in highly competitive markets.

impacts.name: Reliance Industries
impacts.why: New product offerings impact revenue streams and customer retention metrics for the parent company.
